property_summary: A call to fallback that reverts (wrong value or stale timestamp) must leave pastBlockTime unchanged; the mutant writes pastBlockTime=block.timestamp+1 before the timestamp guard, so a reverting call with 10 ether at a timestamp not greater than pastBlockTime corrupts it.
change_summary: Move the pastBlockTime assignment before the timestamp require so reverted-by-guard states still get pastBlockTime updated on failure paths, changing the observable value.
